question: What is the range of total US CO2 across 1990-2022? (A) ~600 Mt (B) ~900 Mt (C) ~1,600 Mt. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: C (~1,600 Mt). Bait: A (~600 Mt).
